entities.text: High Court Of Orissa At Cuttack
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Heard learned Senior Counsel for the petitioner and learned counsel for the State.

2. The petitioner is an accused in connection with G.R. Case No.271 of 2023, pending on the file of the learned S.D.J.M., Kuchinda, arising out of Kuchinda P.S. Case No.95 of 2023, for commission of alleged offences under Sections 376(2)(n)/506 of IPC.
3.

Being aggrieved by the rejection of his application for bail U/s.439 Cr.P.C. by the learned Additional District & Sessions Judge, Kuchinda by order dated 19.06.2023 in the aforementioned case, the present BLAPL has been filed.
4. Perused the 164 Cr.P.C. statement coupled with the statements, which are allegedly circulated by the petitioner.
5. Considering the nature of allegations, this Court is not inclined to entertain the bail application during the currency of investigation.
6. Leave is granted to the petitioner to renew his prayer before the learned Court in seisin post charge sheet which shall be considered on its own merit.
7. Accordingly, the BLAPL stands disposed of.
